FAQs on Hiring JavaScript Developers

What is JavaScript used for?

JavaScript is the main language used for building dynamic web pages and interactive web apps. JavaScript is key to improving user experiences, validating data, and making things work in real-time. On the back end, it runs event-driven apps that can handle a significant number of connections at the same time.

What are JavaScript frameworks?

JavaScript frameworks are very important to companies because they speed up web development, ensure consistency, and make it possible to scale. They provide ready-made solutions and code standards, which shorten the time it takes to get a product on the market and make sure that applications can be maintained as a business grows. Also, frameworks like Angular and Vue.js have communities that help each other out. These communities improve resources and address security concerns, which saves money and protects against common web flaws.

What is full-stack JavaScript?

Fullstack JavaScript means using just one programming language, JavaScript, to build both the front-end, the visible part of a website, and the back end, the hidden part that handles data and actions behind the scenes. For businesses, this is like using a single tool to build everything, making it easier to create websites faster, maintain them better, and scale when the right time comes. 

You can make your MVP development cycle faster and cheaper by using JS full stack development for fast testing. In production, you can use full stack JavaScript to make global (isomorphic) single-page apps that are good for SEO and have a smooth user experience.

What are the main features of JavaScript libraries?

JavaScript libraries are pre-written collections of code that are aimed to make web development easier and more efficient. They provide reusable functions and components for typical activities, which promotes code reuse and efficiency. These libraries frequently address concerns such as cross-browser compatibility, and abstract difficult tasks, and active support and maintenance communities. 

They can give tools for handling events, Ajax queries, and user interface components, as well as add additional functionality and simplify DOM manipulation. Popular libraries include jQuery and React, each having its own set of strengths and applications. Choosing a library is determined by project requirements and developer preferences, and they frequently include documentation, testing tools, and performance improvements to facilitate development processes.

Do you provide support and maintenance services after deployment?

Of course! We are committed to going above and beyond even after the project is finished. Our team is here to provide you with ongoing support and maintenance for your JavaScript project. This includes fixing any bugs, upgrading frameworks, continuously monitoring the performance, and resolving any technical issues that may arise. We’re dedicated to enhancing the overall performance of your project.

Do you provide NDA and IP protection for my project?

Yes, definitely. Ensuring the security and ownership of your project is of utmost importance. We make sure that you keep full ownership of everything, including NDA, intellectual property rights, source code, and any legal protections that may be required.

Do you assist with technical interviewing?

Yes, we have an extra service that can help make your hiring process more efficient. We offer the option to arrange technical interviews with highly skilled experts for an additional fee. These experts will conduct the interviews and provide you with comprehensive summaries and valuable feedback on the candidates.

Is there any hidden cost involved when we Hire JavaScript Developers from Mobilunity?

No, you only need to pay a monthly fee for a dedicated resource that works full-time. If you have any specific hardware or software requirements beyond our basic package, the price might cover the cost of purchasing those extra tools or technologies.

How fast can you hire dedicated Javascript developers?

The time it takes to complete a project can vary depending on the client’s availability and the amount of feedback we receive. However, on average, it usually takes about 4-6 weeks from the start of development to project completion. When it comes to CVs, you can anticipate reviewing them within a week. If you find any candidates that catch your interest, you can then schedule interviews either during that same week or the following week.

What is included in your services?

Our full range of services includes HR, hardware/software, accounting/legal help, and more. Our team of specialized finance and resource management teams make sure that you and the crew are able to discuss and solve problems easily throughout the project. We concentrate on your success.
